purpose: Machine-readable manufacture/install/lookdev summary for benchmark-visible municipal park and street furniture. Assembly-specific contracts are authoritative when they provide more detailed geometry/interface values. This is implementation evidence only; visual points require actual Unity renders.

authorityPolicy.rule: The aggregate contract may summarize an assembly but must not contradict its assembly-specific contract. Final prepared-scene QA executes the specific validators and therefore specific interface contracts control dimensions, interfaces and LOD membership.

referenceBasis.requirement: slide surface SUS304 thickness >=1.5 mm; SUS304 side sheet >=1.5 mm or painted steel side sheet >=2.3 mm
referenceBasis.useInModel: 2.0 mm SUS304 running/side sheet thickness is a reference-bounded design assumption; exact manufacturer drawing for the fictional scene asset is not available.

referenceBasis.requirement: stainless slide example H2455 x W670 x L4185 mm; stainless sliding surface
referenceBasis.useInModel: confirms the scene slide's roughly four-metre run and stainless material class are physically plausible; it is not treated as the exact scene model.

assemblies.periodIntent: ordinary Japanese municipal/neighborhood park equipment plausible for the late 1980s through early 2000s
assemblies.manufacture: welded painted-steel pipe support/deck/access structure with a separately fabricated watertight SUS304 U-section chute solid; access uses individual treads, side brackets, stringers, handrails and ground/deck support interfaces
assemblies.installation: support/load paths terminate through explicit brackets, crossmembers and grade plates while generated visual geometry remains collider-free and legacy gameplay collision remains separate
assemblies.orientation: chute falls toward local +Z; surface centerline transitions from an approximately 26.6 degree initial slope to an approximately 1.7 degree runout; access rises toward the deck from the opposite side
assemblies.exposure: full outdoor midsummer sun/rain; upward stainless, painted treads/rails and horizontal joints receive strongest solar/water exposure while hand/foot contact creates localized polish

components.name: deck
components.evidence_status: structural visual proxy, not claimed manufacturer sheet thickness

components.name: stainless chute U-section
components.geometry: single watertight fabricated section with 96/48/24/12 longitudinal sections in LOD0/1/2/3 and zero allowed boundary/non-manifold edges

assemblies.interfaces: treads bear through welded brackets into side stringers; access rails terminate into platform guard; chute head/runout are closed physical sheet ends and load-bearing joins may not float or interpenetrate
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: sheet thickness, U-section side height, pipe/plate dimensions, treads, brackets, stringers, rails and fasteners are geometry; fine stainless abrasion, paint orange-peel/chalking and contamination are material-scale detail
agingCauses: fine abrasion along stainless chute travel direction

assemblies.manufacture: five timber seat slats mechanically fastened to a steel bearer supported by two precast concrete legs with an explicit timber-to-steel-to-concrete load path
assemblies.installation: slat undersides bear on the steel bearer; the bearer bears on the precast supports; supports extend below grade while only the above-grade lowest contact zone receives the causal moisture/splash material
assemblies.orientation: slats run along local X; real air gaps are perpendicular to the long grain
assemblies.exposure: upward timber receives direct midsummer UV/rain; supports receive splash/capillary moisture near grade

components.name: precast supports
components.finish: dry precast concrete above causal grade-contact zone

assemblies.interfaces: slat/bearer and bearer/support contact errors are fail-closed by the dedicated interface QA; the lower visible support zone darkens/roughens causally without becoming protruding geometry
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: five slats, real air gaps, bearer, supports and fasteners are geometry; grain/checks, UV bleaching and local polish are material-scale detail
agingCauses: sun bleaching on upward timber faces
capillary moisture and splash at concrete feet
forbidden: single giant wood cube at close range

assemblies.periodIntent: ordinary Japanese neighborhood/municipal retained-globe park lamp plausible around 2000; not a claim of one exact manufacturer model
assemblies.manufacture: continuous tapered spun/precast-concrete visual pole shell with a curved weather-sealed service cover, inserted painted-metal pole-top adapter, lower/upper globe retainers, weather cap and topology-aware aged dielectric diffuser
assemblies.installation: pole extends 80 mm below visible grade; concrete taper is continuous from 190 mm diameter at grade to 125 mm at the 3.92 m top; service gasket/cover follows pole curvature; adapter/retainers/globe/cap use explicit millimetre-scale insertion/bearing relationships
assemblies.orientation: local +Y vertical; service cover faces local +Z toward the benchmark-camera side; diffuser remains axisymmetric
assemblies.exposure: full exterior midsummer weather; cap/globe receive direct sun/rain while the lowest 200 mm above grade receives causal splash/capillary darkening on the same pole surface

components.name: causal moisture zone
components.geometry: same pole surface via material submesh; never a protruding ring

components.name: aged diffuser
components.geometry: lathed retained-neck profile; dedicated installation QA verifies head overlaps and LOD membership

assemblies.periodAccuracy: retained globe/mercury-vapor-era visual language; explicitly reject a modern flat LED luminaire
assemblies.interfaces: adapter inserts into pole/lower retainer by 2 mm targets, lower and upper retainers overlap the diffuser necks by 5 mm targets, cap bears on upper retainer, and service cover/gasket allow no positive gap above 3 mm
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: continuous taper, grade embed, curved service gasket/cover, fastener heads, adapter/retainers/cap and diffuser silhouette are geometry; concrete aggregate, causal moisture optics, paint orange-peel/chalking, EPDM grain and diffuser frost/wiping haze are material detail
agingCauses: diffuse UV haze and wiping micro-scratches on the globe
fine runoff contamination at retainer/cap edges

assemblies.periodIntent: ordinary passive neighborhood/municipal notice board plausible for the late 1990s through early 2000s; printed paper notices sit behind a clear weather cover
assemblies.manufacture: two painted tubular posts support a 75 mm-deep framed weatherproof display case containing a recessed backing, individual printed notices, a 3 mm clear UV-stabilized acrylic cover, EPDM perimeter retention, three hinge knuckles, a right-side latch and a top runoff hood
assemblies.installation: two post feet meet ground separately; rigid frame spans the posts; backing is recessed behind the frame face; paper sheets seat on the backing; clear cover is retained in front with positive dry-air separation and left-hinge/right-latch hardware
assemblies.orientation: board face is approximately vertical and faces local +Z toward the benchmark camera side; frame rails wrap all four edges
assemblies.exposure: top hood and upper frame receive strongest sun/rain; clear cover receives runoff/wiping; backing and papers are sheltered; post feet receive splash

components.name: printed notices
components.print_rule: ink/text is material texture detail, not raised geometry

assemblies.interfaces: paper backs contact the recessed backing within 1 mm; paper-to-cover dry-air gap remains at least 20 mm; clear-cover edge clearance inside the frame is 30-70 mm; drip hood bears on the frame within 2.5 mm; hinge/latch axes remain on their respective frame rails
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: case depth, back panel, clear-cover thickness, gasket, hinges, latch, hood, paper thickness and LOD0 pins are geometry; printed ink, paper fibre, acrylic wiping haze, paint microstructure, fine oxidation and UV fading are material detail
assemblies.periodAccuracy: no digital display, QR code, LED panel or other post-2000 electronic signage cue; notice occupancy persists through all four LODs to avoid content-class pop
forbidden: opaque rectangle pretending to be a clear cover

materials.microstructure: subtle orange-peel/chalking; no specular baked into albedo
materials.wetness: only localized after rain; dry benchmark default
materials.angularResponse: dielectric Fresnel; no metallic edge tint
materials.implementationStatus: final microdetail keeps the optically visible coating dielectric

materials.microstructure: fine directional abrasion along travel direction
materials.wetness: dry benchmark default; an explicit rain state would lower apparent roughness rather than paint a highlight
materials.uvAging: none beyond contamination; stainless does not chalk like paint
materials.angularResponse: strong grazing reflection driven by environment and Fresnel, never painted highlight
materials.implementationStatus: authoritative park microdetail overrides the early bootstrap 0.86 scalar to fully metallic exposed stainless
authoritative park microdetail enforces bareMetalMetallicMin >= 0.95; aggregate intent is fully exposed metal

materials.microstructure: grain/checks run with slat length; geometry handles slat gaps
materials.wetness: darkens and reduces roughness only in an explicit rain state
materials.uvAging: up-facing slats may desaturate more than protected undersides
materials.angularResponse: dielectric Fresnel with broad finish response
materials.implementationStatus: final microdetail uses directional wood structure; render verification remains pending

materials.uvAging: minor tone change; no metallic or glossy aging
materials.implementationStatus: scalar PBR plus separate causally darker contact material implemented; native-4K tuning remains pending

lod.policy: LOD0 retains fasteners and highest curve/profile tessellation; LOD1/2/3 reduce sub-pixel components/tessellation while preserving construction-critical silhouette, material class and physical interfaces
lod.criticalFail: visible pop or silhouette/material-class discontinuity in benchmark motion

criticalAutomaticFail: visible primitive-placeholder geometry in benchmark framing
